_schema: ccteam dev-flow config v1 — fill every TODO before launching
name: TODO-project-slug
description: TODO short one-liner about what this project is
_local_path_note: absolute path to the project's git working tree; agents cd here on every turn

github._note: dev opens PRs against fix_base_branch; reviewer merges into the same. production_branch is NEVER touched by automation.
github._review_strategy_note: squash | merge | rebase — passed to `gh pr merge --<strategy>`

test._note: shell commands the dev bot runs before opening PR. Each entry runs in the worktree cwd; non-zero exit = blocks the PR.

worktree._note: where dev creates ephemeral worktrees per PR. .ccteam-worktrees/ is gitignored by convention.

ops._note: ops bot health scan tunables. Set thresholds project-by-project.

_im_note: IM platform comes from ccteam-imd configuration (see /telegram:configure or /ccteam-im-setup). config.json doesn't carry the bot token — that lives in keychain / .env. This block is just a hint for bots that need to identify the active platform in their messages.
